decision: Do not select a binary-option L2 source or start broad backfill until the chosen source sample is converted into NT-native data classes, written to ParquetDataCatalog under the artifact root, queried back, and consumed by BacktestNode.

nt_capability_evidence.capability: ParquetDataCatalog supports NT-native writes for order-book deltas, depth10, trades, bars, quotes, prices, statuses, closes, and custom data.
ParquetDataCatalog writes InstrumentAny instruments separately from market data.
ParquetDataCatalog supports typed read-back through query_typed_data.
ParquetDataCatalog has convenience typed queries for TradeTick, OrderBookDelta, and OrderBookDepth10.
BacktestDataConfig/NautilusDataType includes OrderBookDelta and OrderBookDepth10 in addition to TradeTick.
BacktestNode dispatches ParquetDataCatalog queries for TradeTick, OrderBookDelta, and OrderBookDepth10.
Pinned NT Polymarket provider indexes loaded instruments by token id for asset_id joins.
Pinned NT Polymarket parser derives BinaryOption fields from Gamma market definitions.
Pinned NT Polymarket constructs InstrumentAny::BinaryOption through BinaryOption::new_checked.
Pinned NT Polymarket websocket parser converts snapshots and price changes to OrderBookDeltas and trades to TradeTick.

Pinned NT exposes nautilus_polymarket http, providers, websocket messages, and websocket parse modules publicly, so parser/provider reuse is a dependency-wiring issue rather than a missing NT surface for the bounded PMXT proof.
Pinned NT Polymarket public APIs include PolymarketInstrumentProvider token lookup, Gamma market parsing, BinaryOption construction/rebuild, websocket message structs, and book/trade parsers.

bolt_current_limitations.limitation: Pinned NT's historical Polymarket build_polymarket_trade_id helper is pub(crate), so BTE cannot directly call it through nautilus-polymarket even after the dependency is added.

The manifest/data-config path now maps TradeTick and OrderBookDelta plus configured instrument_ids, but this proves only NT data-config construction, not PMXT source-row projection or BacktestNode consumption of a verified PMXT L2 catalog.

The catalog hash/read-back path now covers an NT-native BinaryOption, OrderBookDelta, and TradeTick fixture, but production source projection is still the CurrencyPair plus TradeTick canonical-trades path and no PMXT source-row adapter exists yet.

source_mapping_status.required_path: Approve BTE dependency/integration path to pinned nautilus-polymarket, reuse NT Polymarket instrument parser/provider, normalize PMXT archive rows generically, write InstrumentAny::BinaryOption plus OrderBookDelta/TradeTick into ParquetDataCatalog, and query them back.

first_proof_policy_status.summary: A bounded first PMXT Polymarket L2 proof may select an unaffected instrument universe with tick_size_change_rows == 0, book_rows > 0, price_change_rows > 0, last_trade_price_rows > 0, and a configured row budget. This is a TOML/source-proof-owned selector, not a venue or asset constant. It can prove catalog/read-back/BacktestNode plumbing only for the selected unaffected universe.
